text:
kevin: Hi team, I'm resigning today. Last day 2026-07-09. Based in Bengaluru. Questions: gratuity eligibility, PF/ESIC closure timeline, and immigration COE for visa. cc @priya
priya (people-ops): Thanks, Kevin. Sorry to see you go. Will you be in office for handover week? That affects badge return and pickup timing.
sanjeev (manager): Please keep 07/08-07/09 open for KT with infra. We'll try to do most remotely but onsite for equipment return is fine.
kevin: I'll be onsite 07/08 morning to drop equipment and sign forms. About gratuity  am I eligible? I joined in 2021.
priya (people-ops): Gratuity typically vests after 5 years; you'll be short. Final settlement will include accrued leave payout and any contractual notice pay. Payroll will run a settlement calc after you submit the offboard form.
kevin: OK. What about PF/ESIC closure and Form 16?
priya (people-ops): Payroll issues Form 16 for the FY. PF/ESIC account closures and transfer details take ~2-3 weeks; we'll provide the passbook extract and next steps.
raja (it): Device return: we can schedule courier pickup or you can hand in at office 07/08. Corporate SIM will be deactivated on deprovision. Which is easier?
kevin: I'll hand in at office 07/08. I need email access through 07/15 for final vendor payments. No code commits after 07/09.
raja (it): Standard deprovision plan:
```
/offboard --user kevin --badge-off 2026-07-08 --slack-off 2026-07-12 --email-off 2026-07-16 --sso-off 2026-07-16
```
We can keep email until 07/15 as requested and will rotate keys after that.
kevin: I have two non-prod keys and one PagerDuty token. I'll list them on the offboard form.
sanjeev (manager): I'll take ownership of the service keys once Kevin lists them. Raja, please rotate and hand over.
legal@redwood: Quick ask: confirm if your offer letter includes IP assignment and any post-termination restrictions. We'll check the clause and advise.
kevin: It includes IP assignment and a 3-month non-solicit. No garden leave noted.
legal@redwood: Noted. Non-solicit is limited; we'll DM formal language.
offboard-bot: [OFF-2333] Ticket created for kevin. People-ops to confirm payroll schedule.
priya (people-ops): Please complete the offboard form and upload any outstanding vendor invoices. We'll issue COE within 3 business days after HR sign-off.
kevin: Will fill the form tonight and upload invoices. Please email gratuity summary.
priya (people-ops): Copying payroll & comp teams. We'll confirm PF closure timing and equity exercise window separately. Thanks, Kevin.
kevin: Thanks everyone for the quick responses. Appreciate the coordination.
